messages:
Priya R: Aurora reported intermittent "GPU has fallen off the bus" + NVML init failures when they overlay their signed driver on our marketplace image. Ticket AUR-512.
Emilia (aurora-liaison): Confirmed. Fails in our preflight on 8x A100, mostly under batched generation. We can provide their signed bundle for repro.
Jonas H: Which driver/CUDA/runtime combo?
Priya R: They sent: driver 525.85 (signed overlay), CUDA 12.2, image redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-c. Sequence lengths ~1500-2048. Failure pattern: dmesg Xid 31, nvidia-modeset atomic run failed.
Ahmed K: Sounds similar to other DKMS/LTO module interactions. Quick mitigations: pin driver to 520 in image, or fall back runtime to CUDA12.1. Also consider routing Aurora traffic to Dedicated pools while we triage.
InfraBot: repro job queued: aurora-a100-repro-1749999999 on infra-lab-12 (ETA ~12m)
Priya R: Repro in our lab with Aurora bundle: NVML init fails ~40s into harness. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-diagnostics/aurora/AUR-512/1749999999.tar.gz
Jonas H: Starting small bisect (drivers: 520.61, 525.85, 530.18) to isolate regression.
InfraBot: matrix started: driver-bisect-1749999999
Jonas H: Bisect result: 525.85 reproduces, 520.61 and 530.18 pass. Module build flags look different in 525 (LTO-ish options).
Marta L: OK. Actionable options: 1) publish emergency marketplace image pinned to driver 520 for affected SKUs; 2) offer customers a CUDA12.1 compatibility lane; 3) work with Aurora/vendor to rebuild signed bundle without the problematic flags. Need partner signoff for rollback image.
Sam R (release-manager): Proposed process: build image with driver 520 + same runtime, smoke test, publish to marketplace canary 5% during maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC, run Aurora telemetry and ramp if stable. I'll draft advisory copy.
Emilia (aurora-liaison): Aurora agrees to the window and 5% canary. They prefer a short patch rather than disrupting their signed overlay.
Ahmed K: I'll prepare smoke scripts and monitor eBPF/NVML traces during canary.
Jonas H: I'll attach bisect logs and a short note for vendor engineers about the suspect module flags.
Priya R: Uploaded repro artifacts and basic run command we used:
``` 
docker run --gpus all --rm -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0-7 redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-c python3 tests/harness.py --profile aurora
```
Marta L: I'll assemble the joint runbook (repro artifacts, bisect summary, rollback steps, customer advisory draft) and add owners. Ping @here for urgent updates. :white_check_mark:
